derivation.v5_replacement:
soc_pcie_gen3_recovered_front_x4_v1 #(.FIFO_DEPTH(FIFO_DEPTH)) shared_front (
        .por_ni(por_ni), .reset_i(reset_i), .recovered_clk_i(recovered_clk_i), .common_clk_i(common_clk_i),
        .raw_valid_i(raw_valid_i), .raw_i(raw_i), .align_control_i(align_control_i), .force_realign_i(force_realign_i),
        .lane_running_o(lane_running_o), .lane_aligned_o(lane_aligned_o), .lane_locked_o(lane_locked_o), .lane_fault_o(lane_fault_o),
        .common_running_o(common_running), .common_fault_o(common_fault),
        .record_valid_o(raw_valid), .record_ready_i(raw_ready & {4{front_ready}}),
        .record_block_o(raw_block), .record_length_code_o(raw_length),
        .record_skp_o(raw_skp), .record_eieos_o(raw_eieos), .record_realign_o(raw_realign)
    );
    genvar lane;
    generate for (lane=0; lane<4; lane=lane+1) begin: lanes

limitations: The testbench supplies ideal recovered clocks and raw bits; no serial analog PMA is modeled.
The raw shared front preserves opaque OS records without declaring TS/EQ semantics or assigning logical lanes.
All-lane readiness and parser/decode fault ownership remain in the normal consumer.
No top-level soc_top or physical layout is changed. Training owner, normative TS/EQ oracle and state handoff remain open.
The comparison harness duplicates original/candidate chains only in verification. Production must elaborate one shared front and four CDC FIFOs.
